interval_status: All intervals are Student-t/delta diagnostics excluding mixing and numerical bias, not certified coverage. Bonferroni alone cannot repair this.
timing_caveat: Main timer starts before model load, excludes interpreter/import and the final BAR histogram analysis. Peak is captured before final analysis, so it is not whole-process peak. Concurrent host work means no isolated speedup claim.
forward_backward_note: Sensitivity cross-check only, not an independent-sample or mixed-chain certificate.
